description: Planning carries out-of-band findings that match a planned path into a Known Findings section, and leaves unrelated findings out.
failure_mode: Model ignores a recorded finding about a file it plans to change, or pastes every finding regardless of the planned paths.
prompt: The plan modifies scripts/ci-local.sh. `nightgauge finding list --match-paths scripts/ci-local.sh --json` returns one finding: kind environment, scope pipeline, summary 'Gate needs mikefarah yq', remedy 'brew install yq before scripts/ci-local.sh'. The findings file also holds 'Seed data needs migrations first', which did not match. Write the plan's findings section, and put the section itself in one fenced markdown block.
